question: What is my best-selling item overall?
gold_sql: SELECT mi.name AS gold_value FROM order_items oi JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.item_id = oi.item_id GROUP BY mi.item_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What were my five best-selling items last weekend?
gold_sql: SELECT mi.name AS gold_value FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.item_id = oi.item_id WHERE o.is_weekend = 1 AND date(o.order_datetime) > date((SELECT MAX(order_datetime) FROM orders), '-7 day') GROUP BY mi.item_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1
notes: one of the proposal's own example questions

question: Which menu item has the lowest profit margin?
gold_sql: SELECT name AS gold_value FROM menu_items ORDER BY (price_usd - cost_usd) / price_usd ASC LIMIT 1
notes: one of the proposal's own example questions; gold is Fish & Chips by design

question: Which menu item has the highest profit margin?
gold_sql: SELECT name AS gold_value FROM menu_items ORDER BY (price_usd - cost_usd) / price_usd DESC LIMIT 1

question: Did Arsenal match days lift beer sales?
gold_sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.is_match_day, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mi.category='Beer' THEN oi.quantity END),0) beer_qty FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.item_id=oi.item_id GROUP BY o.order_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG(beer_qty),2) AS gold_value FROM per_order WHERE is_match_day=1
notes: one of the proposal's own example questions; gold is the match-day average beer qty/order

question: How many orders have we had in total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS gold_value FROM orders

question: What is our total revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_total_usd),2) AS gold_value FROM order_items

question: What is the average order value?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total_usd)*1.0/COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id),2) AS gold_value FROM order_items oi

question: Which menu category sells the most units?
gold_sql: SELECT mi.category AS gold_value FROM order_items oi JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.item_id=oi.item_id GROUP BY mi.category ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What share of our orders are paid via EcoCash?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN payment_method='ecocash' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*),1) AS gold_value FROM orders

question: Which ingredients are running low on stock?
gold_sql: SELECT name AS gold_value FROM ingredients WHERE stock_on_hand <= reorder_level LIMIT 1
notes: gold is Fish Fillet (imported), the one ingredient seeded below its reorder level

question: What is the most expensive item on the menu?
gold_sql: SELECT name AS gold_value FROM menu_items ORDER BY price_usd DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the cheapest item on the menu?
gold_sql: SELECT name AS gold_value FROM menu_items ORDER BY price_usd ASC LIMIT 1

question: How many different beers do we sell?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS gold_value FROM menu_items WHERE category='Beer'

question: What is our total revenue on weekends?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total_usd),2) AS gold_value FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=oi.order_id WHERE o.is_weekend=1

question: What has our average USD to ZWG exchange rate been?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(usd_to_zwg),2) AS gold_value FROM fx_rates

question: What's in the Peri-Peri Chicken and how much does it cost?
gold_sql: SELECT price_usd AS gold_value FROM menu_items WHERE name='Peri-Peri Chicken'
notes: exercises the needs_retrieval path from Phase 05; only the price half is scored numerically

question: How many orders did we have yesterday?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS gold_value FROM orders WHERE date(order_datetime) = date((SELECT MAX(order_datetime) FROM orders), '-1 day')
notes: stress-tests the reference_date design from Phase 03 (dataset is a fixed historical window, not live)

question: How many Arsenal matches are on our calendar?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS gold_value FROM match_days

question: Which starter sells the best?
gold_sql: SELECT mi.name AS gold_value FROM order_items oi JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.item_id=oi.item_id WHERE mi.category='Starter' GROUP BY mi.item_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1
